document.abstract: Good morning ladies and gentlemen, members and guests. Welcome to the 25th Annual Television Conference of the Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers. Welcome also to the “Motor City”. The theme of this conference “A Television Continuum – 1967–2017” and the papers to be presented today and tomorrow should, we hope, generate much interest as to where we have been, where we are now, and where we are going into the future.
